## X-Sense Home Security v1.4.25

This release improves entity setup, diagnostics, and refresh reliability.

### Entity Reliability
- Avoids device-registry writes while Home Assistant is creating entities and resolves child-to-base-station links after parent registration.
- Keeps existing sensors stable when a cloud refresh temporarily omits a field.
- Marks controls unavailable when their required setting or write route is no longer present instead of failing during an action.

### Device Diagnostics
- Keeps Security Mode and Device Time Zone on SBS50 base stations instead of exposing them on standalone detectors.
- Exposes self-test result sensors only after the device actually reports a test result.
- Preserves payload-backed alarm and silence entities while removing stale entities that are not supported by the current device data.
- Aligns Device Time Zone naming across supported languages.

### Regression Coverage
- Adds checks for parent registration order, partial refreshes, control availability, and entity cleanup.
